metadata.title: Delhi’s Crispiest Dosa and Softest Idli with Filter Coffee and Rava Kesari @ Dosa Coffee Restaurant
metadata.description:
For Delhiites, South Indian food often means indulging in crispy dosas, fluffy idlis, savory vadas, rich sambhar, and, of course, a cup of aromatic filter coffee. Our search for the most authentic South Indian fare in the city led us to Dosa Coffee in Connaught Place. Originally from Kolkata, Dosa Coffee now has 12 outlets across Delhi NCR, and has quickly become a go-to spot for those craving genuine South Indian flavors.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed into an open kitchen that was clean, hygienic, and equipped with modern appliances. Watching the chefs skillfully prepare vadas and three types of dosa was a treat in itself. The ambiance was cozy, and the service impressively fast.

The dosas were a sheer delight—crisp, golden, and absolutely delicious. They came with a vibrant assortment of chutneys that perfectly complemented their crunchy texture, showcasing the attention to detail in every serving. 

If you're on the hunt for an authentic South Indian dining experience in Delhi, Dosa Coffee is a must-visit. Watch the full episode for all the yummy details!


DOSA COFFEE
P-24/90, Connaught Cir, near Shivaji Hockey Stadium, Block P, Connaught Place, New Delhi
